lanes.summary: FAIL: `scripts/binary_snapshot.sh` line 171 contains `if cmp -s "$work/a" "$work/a"; then`, comparing the first snapshot file against itself instead of comparing `"$work/a"` against `"$work/b"`. This makes the `--twice` determinism check a tautology that cannot fail on differing snapshots, refuting both thePMAT-257 acceptance criteria and the receipt's claim at `docs/audits/impl-PMAT-257-receipt.md:60`.

findings.claim: `--twice` determinism check is a tautology: `if cmp -s "$work/a" "$work/a"; then` compares `$work/a` against itself instead of against `$work/b`, so `--twice` can never detect non-determinism between the two snapshots written on lines 169-170.
findings.fix: Change line 171 from `if cmp -s "$work/a" "$work/a"; then` to `if cmp -s "$work/a" "$work/b"; then`.
